title: Independent fixed-budget window confirmation of Chapter 2 assigned expression-order effects
motivation: Previous 64-history expression-order full-grid primary was practically equivalent; budget 3-4 localization was discovered after outcome exposure and is NOT confirmation.

estimand.type: two-sided visitor-history paired window residual in far-minus-near A-first-minus-I-first occupancy difference-in-differences
estimand.interpolation: linear interpolation of DID on log(budget) between budgets 2 and 5, subtract from mean of window budgets 3 and 4
estimand.settings_pool: four reproductive settings equally weighted within each visitor history
estimand.future_pool: both future environments and both nested demographic repeats
estimand.equivalent: full bootstrap95 lies strictly inside [-0.05,+0.05], otherwise inconclusive unless supported

smooth_comparator.basis: cubic polynomial in centered natural-log ovule budget
smooth_comparator.alternative: same cubic basis plus one prespecified budget-3-or-4 indicator
smooth_comparator.validation: 8-fold holdout by visitor-history identity, all 7 budgets carried together
smooth_comparator.loss: per-history mean squared error of DID across 7 budgets
smooth_comparator.criterion: 95% history-bootstrap interval of held-out (smooth loss minus smooth-plus-window loss) entirely above zero and mean >=0.0001

guards: No simulation of new history IDs in PR tests, manual preflight, or cost engineering.
Both expression-order arms retain exactly the old frozen assignments and equal doses; biological source modules untouched.
The previous 64 exposed histories are used ONLY for hypothesis generation; independent IDs are mandatory.
All 2048 complete founder-genotype states and 57344 full 28-fork futures required before adjudication.
Never treat nested repeats, future branches, or budgets as independent ecological replicates.
A cubic smooth comparator is not a fully general ecological smooth-null; passing is evidence of localized predictive improvement relative to this specified comparator, not proof of a discontinuity.
Intermediate-window evidence can remain inconclusive even when a selected single budget exceeds 0.05.
Retain failed independent16 mutation-priority result and prior pooled practical-equivalence result without retrospective reinterpretation.
Historical plant-island generalization is not identifiable from synthetic stress tests.
